name: JoAi: Send Campaign to Contact

title.en: Send a campaign to a contact
title.fr: Envoyer une campagne à un contact
title.es: Enviar una campaña a un contacto
title.it: Invia una campagna a un contatto

description.en: Send an email or messaging campaign to a single contact. Useful as a follow-up after a form submission: pass the submitted email and the campaign goes out immediately or after a delay.
description.de: Sende eine E-Mail- oder Messaging-Kampagne an einen einzelnen Kontakt. Ideal als Follow-up nach einer Formular-Einreichung: Gib die eingereichte E-Mail an, die Kampagne geht sofort oder nach einer Verzögerung raus.

bot: Use when the user wants to send a campaign to a specific contact (e.g. as a form follow-up). Provide the campaign ID and the contact email; optionally a name and a delay like '2h' or '3d'.

inputs.name: Campaign ID

description.en: The hashid of the campaign to send
description.de: Die Hashid der zu sendenden Kampagne
description.fr: Le hashid de la campagne à envoyer
description.es: El hashid de la campaña a enviar

inputs.bot: The campaign hash ID. If the user refers to a campaign by name, list campaigns first to find the matching ID.

description.en: The contact's email address to send the campaign to
description.de: Die E-Mail-Adresse des Kontakts, an den die Kampagne gehen soll

description.en: Optional delay before sending, e.g. '30m', '2h', or '3d'
description.de: Optionale Verzögerung vor dem Versand, z.B. '30m', '2h' oder '3d'

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug of the campaign. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug der Kampagne. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team the campaign belongs to. Omit to use the current team.

error.en: Failed to send campaign to contact: {{MESSAGE}}
error.de: Kampagne konnte nicht an den Kontakt gesendet werden: {{MESSAGE}}
